# Local Lottie player

The extension bundles the light SVG player from [lottie-web 5.13.0](https://www.npmjs.com/package/lottie-web/v/5.13.0) under the [MIT license](LICENSE.md).

- Package file `build/player/lottie_light.min.js`, copied byte for byte.
- Player SHA-256 `9588432bec30c8ef8200bac4a67d8aaad881047bc2a6c9fa624d90ec96402410`.
- npm archive SHA-256 `00f306a9b5669abf9622c418b549681d1b858e0b7fa7ea6adc0772ca57c3fd4f`.

The [astronaut composition](../animations/astronaut_light_theme.json) has its own [Lottie Simple License](../animations/astronaut_light_theme.LICENSE.txt).
